questions.prompt: Which of these tracks on *Bayaan* (2018) is a skit, not a full song?
questions.explanation: "Jolly" is a 23-second skit. *Bayaan* has 9 songs plus an intro and two skits, "Jolly" and "EDOKDOG". "Uss Din", "Dehshat" and "PNP" are full songs.

bar: Nigla use vaha pe ek ajgar
questions.prompt: The bar twists an old saying. What does the original saying mock?

options.text: A sinner's sudden show of piety
Pride that comes before a fall
A long journey that ends badly

questions.explanation: The saying is "nau sau chuhe kha ke billi hajj ko chali": after eating 900 rats, the cat goes on Hajj. It mocks a sinner who suddenly acts holy. The bar keeps the set-up and adds its own payoff: a python swallows the cat.

questions.prompt: Clue card. Real name Siddhant Sharma. Produced most of *Lunch Break* (2023). Dropped a solo tape, *PentHouse Tapes, Vol. 1*, in Feb 2026. Who is it?
questions.explanation: Calm is Siddhant Sharma. He raps and makes beats, and he produced most of the 30-track *Lunch Break*.

questions.prompt: Taken word for word, what does "Seedhe Maut" mean?
questions.explanation: It means "straight to death", used like "sick" or "dope". The duo say it means no half measures: give everything to what you start.

questions.prompt: Which Seedhe Maut song is this? A July 2021 single with MC Stan, later on the mixtape *न*, named after a martial-arts weapon.
questions.explanation: "Nanchaku" (23 Jul 2021) is the song's spelling of nunchaku, two sticks joined by a chain. Wild City said each rapper "offers a different flow" on it.

questions.prompt: Where did Encore ABJ and Calm first meet?

options.text: SPIT DOPE, a Delhi cypher night

questions.explanation: Encore co-founded SPIT DOPE, a Delhi night of cyphers and rap battles. Vice says he met Calm at its first session, in 2016.

questions.prompt: Why does "fielding" follow "Kaif"?

options.text: Kaif was famed for his fielding

questions.explanation: Mohammad Kaif was one of India's best outfielders. Encore is the expert, and his rival keeps misfielding.

bar: Ulte paao bhagte ye saare jaise (Pret sab)
questions.prompt: Simile or metaphor?
questions.explanation: "Jaise" (like) marks a simile. In North Indian folklore, backward feet are a ghost's sign, so his rivals run off like ghosts.

questions.prompt: Clue card. Real name Abhijay Negi. Says he found Eminem at about age 11 to 13. In 2023 he said: "There's a reason TBSM4L is a thing." Who is it?
questions.explanation: Encore ABJ is Abhijay Negi, one half of Seedhe Maut with Calm.

questions.prompt: Their debut album *Bayaan* (Dec 2018) is co-credited to Seedhe Maut and which producer?
questions.explanation: Apple Music credits *Bayaan* to "Seedhe Maut & Sez on the Beat". Before release, Rolling Stone India reported that Sez was producing the whole album. They shared the credit again on *Nayaab* (2022).

questions.prompt: *Bayaan*, *न*, *Nayaab* and *Lunch Break* all came out on one label, which the duo left in 2023. Which label?
questions.explanation: Azadi had signed them by April 2018. Rolling Stone India reported that the duo confirmed in 2023 that they had left.

questions.prompt: The EPs *SHAKTI* and *Kshama* came out on the duo's own label. What is it called?
questions.explanation: DL91 Era is also on *DL91 FM* (2025) and "Dilli Jale Roz" (2026). MAAL is their merch line, not a label.

questions.prompt: Which launch artist joined "Swah!" from *Lunch Break* (2023) as a last-minute feature?
questions.explanation: Badshah's verse came in late, on one of Calm's oldest beats. Badshah later put the duo on "Bajenge" from his album *Ek Tha Raja* (2024).

questions.type: identify the artist (who said this bar?)
bar: Aur baju apni beat pe ni dhundta type beat
questions.explanation: A "type beat" copies a famous rapper's sound. Calm makes Seedhe Maut's own beats (he produced most of *Lunch Break*), so he doesn't need one.

questions.type: identify the artist (who said this bar?)
questions.lead: Only one verse of "Nanchaku" says the title
questions.prompt: Who raps it?
questions.explanation: The guest says the title, not Seedhe Maut. "Banda khuda ka" means God's own man. Stan's verse is the one with Bambaiya forms like "meko" and "kaiku".

bar: Jalebi, humse, jale bhi saath hain
questions.prompt: Which two meanings does "jalebi / jale bhi" carry?

options.text: Sweet talk, and burning with envy
A sweet, and a wedding feast
Sweet talk, and a burning stove

questions.explanation: One sound, two meanings (yamak). The snakes talk sweet like jalebi, and they also burn ("jale bhi") with jealousy.

bar: Ghoome mere fan har jagah jaise Khaitaan
questions.prompt: Which two meanings does "fan" carry?
questions.explanation: Khaitan makes ceiling fans. "Ghoome" means both "roam" and "spin", so his followers go everywhere and spin like Khaitan fans. One word, two meanings: shlesh.

questions.prompt: What does "bike" mean here?
questions.explanation: It's Hindi "bi-ke" (from bikna, to be sold): smack (heroin), milk, everything is for sale. In Roman letters it looks like English "bike", but it's said in two syllables. That's sound over spelling.

questions.prompt: In June 2025, Seedhe Maut played which UK festival?
questions.explanation: They played Glastonbury in June 2025. The same UK trip had sold-out shows in Manchester, Birmingham and London.

questions.prompt: *Don't Try This At Home* (20 Nov 2026), the joint EP by KR$NA and Seedhe Maut, is on which label?
questions.explanation: It's on Mass Appeal, like their single "BUZZ" (Oct 2026). Apple Music lists six songs.

questions.prompt: Seedhe Maut, Raga and Aghor are all on "Sanki" (2022). It closes which launch artist's album?
questions.explanation: "Sanki" closes Ikka's *Nishu* (26 Jul 2022, Kalamkaar), on a beat by Sez on the Beat.

questions.type: identify the artist (who said this bar?)
questions.lead: Who raps this bar on "Khatta Flow"?
questions.explanation: It's KR$NA's verse. Ehsaan Noorani is the guitarist of Shankar–Ehsaan–Loy, so "pull strings" means both using contacts and playing guitar.

questions.prompt: Who produced "Dikkat" (from *Lunch Break*, 2023) and the 2023 single "Tofa"?
questions.explanation: Hurricane, whom Rolling Stone India calls their protégé. RS India credits him on "Dikkat", and Shazam credits him on "Tofa". Calm made most of *Lunch Break*. Hurricane is a lead artist on *DL91 FM* (2025).

bar: I'm John Wick with a weapon, bout to kill ‘em parabellum
questions.prompt: "Para bellum" is Latin. What does it mean?
questions.explanation: It's from "Si vis pacem, para bellum": if you want peace, prepare for war. The phrase is also the subtitle of *John Wick: Chapter 3* (2019), so he's John Wick, armed and ready.

questions.prompt: Seedhe Maut told Rolling Stone India (2018) that a Mumbai rapper has a cameo in their "Shaktimaan" video. Who?
questions.explanation: D'Evil appears in the video. The duo wrote its script, CanFuse directed it, and it follows a fed-up bank employee.

questions.type: identify the artist (who said this bar?)
questions.lead: Who raps this bar on "Khatta Flow"?
questions.explanation: It's Calm's verse. "Double" echoes the start of Encore's verse, and "muggle" starts a run of rhymes: struggle, bubble. A muggle is someone with no magic in *Harry Potter*.

questions.prompt: "Dum Pishaach" (2020), with producer Karan Kanchan, was the first collaboration between Azadi Records and which label?
questions.explanation: "Dum Pishaach" (11 Sep 2020) was a rap-rock song and the first Azadi x Gully Gang release. Karan Kanchan was signed to Gully Gang.

questions.prompt: The duo made *Lunch Break* (2023) in Goa, as a break from work on which album?
questions.explanation: "Kavi" and "Kehna Chahte Hain" on *Lunch Break* are preludes to it. As of 20 Nov 2026, *Kavi Kehna Chahte Hain* is still unreleased.

questions.type: identify the artist (who said this bar?)
bar: Tera bhai Karl Marx prophet, dekhe nahi profit
questions.explanation: It's Encore's verse. "Prophet" and "profit" sound almost the same: a holy messenger who ignores money, in a verse full of worship words.

questions.prompt: On 25 Jun 2024, Straight Outta Srinagar (SOS) released "Blackball". Which six-minute track did Seedhe Maut release within 24 hours?
questions.explanation: "TT / Shutdown" came out within a day, written and produced by Calm and Encore ABJ. Apple Music lists "TT" and "SHUTDOWN" as two 2024 singles.

bar: Flyer pe MGK saath, kiya Lace Up
Yaha pe launde bas fly hum (Way up)
questions.prompt: Which festival listed Seedhe Maut on the same bill as MGK?
questions.explanation: VH1 Supersonic 2020 in Pune, with MGK as headliner and Seedhe Maut also on the bill. *Lace Up* is also the title of MGK's debut album (2012).

questions.prompt: The *SHAKTI* EP came out on a national holiday. Which date?
questions.explanation: *SHAKTI* (4 songs, including "Raat Ki Rani") came out on Independence Day 2024. *Kshama* followed on 14 Dec 2024.

questions.prompt: The video for "Bhussi" (2023), KSHMR's heist song with Seedhe Maut, is based on a bank robbery in which Hindi film?
questions.explanation: The video recreates a heist from *Aankhen* (2002), with KSHMR as a news reporter. "Bhussi" is from KSHMR's album *KARAM*, produced by KSHMR and Karan Kanchan.

questions.prompt: Which *Nayaab* song won Best Music Video at the Radio City Freedom Awards (Season 7, March 2023)?
questions.explanation: "Anaadi" won, credited to Seedhe Maut and Sez on the Beat. The winners were announced online on 31 Mar 2023.

bar: Kase khud ke pech vo bhi bina pechkas
questions.prompt: What is a "pechkas"?
questions.explanation: "Pech" (screw) + "kas" (tighten) = "pechkas", a screwdriver. He tightened his own screws without one: he fixed himself with no help.

questions.lead: In Verse 1, Encore ABJ says he's "the one", jaise Neo. Calm, in Verse 2
bar: Bitch I'm the one jaise Jet Li
questions.prompt: What links the two picks?
questions.explanation: Neo is "the One" in *The Matrix*, and Jet Li starred in the 2001 film *The One*. Same set-up, new "One": it reads like a callback between the two verses.
